'''Shellflowers''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Flower/Legends|flower]]. They had soft centers full of sticky [[Syrup/Legends|syrup]]. Primitive beings would use their forefingers to extract the syrup. Over time, the shellflower evolved thorns as a means of defense to ward off the primitive beings, forcing them to invent rudimentary tools for syrup extraction.<ref name="EGTD" />
